title: GLASS ADJUSTMENT PROCEDURE
summary: Convertible (19467) section views for the K14 glass adjustment procedure: how the side door glass should sit against the windshield-side weatherstrip (A-A), convertible top front header (B-B), top side-rail weatherstrip (C-C), convertible top rear weatherstrip (D-D, E-E) and the top side rail (F-F). Dimensions are nominal design values.
notes: Section A-A (glass front edge to w/shield side w/strip): .04 PARALLEL
Section C-C (top side rail w/strip to glass upper edge): .30 PARALLEL; .06 PARALLEL
Section D-D (conv. top rear w/strip): .10 PARALLEL; 38 PARALLEL; label CONV. TOP REAR W/STRIP
Section E-E: labels CONV. TOP REAR W/STRIP, SIDE DOOR GLASS, DOOR W/STRIP
NOTE The dimensions given in these sections are nominal design dimensions.
notes_internal: Drawing-only page for K14 (p153): no callouts, no parts, no torque legend, so no fastening entries.
Section cut lines A-A to F-F are marked on the door-glass/top perspective at upper right.
Section D-D '38 PARALLEL': no decimal point visible at 300 dpi (probably .38, not confirmed).
Section C-C '.30 PARALLEL': the leading dot is merged with the 3 in the scan; reads as on K13.
